links.comparator_used: General-purpose LLMs (e.g., ChatGPT-4o, Grok-3) compared against medical-domain LLMs, 10 models in total, on HCC questions
links.outcome: Expert-rated accuracy and local interpretability across HCC management stages
links.effect: ChatGPT-4o and Grok-3 had the highest accuracy (2.62 ± 0.06, 93%; 2.60 ± 0.06, 95%) and interpretability (0.43; 0.43). General-purpose models outperformed some medical models.
links.quote: General-purpose models outperformed some medical models, revealing limitations in domain-specific fine-tuning.

design_hint: prompt design (structured prompting) to improve LLM answers
